title: The Taxpayer Development Journey: Code
description: Code of the project The Taxpayer Development Journey: A Behavioral Lifecycle Architecture for Tax Compliance: Evidence from Tanzania: the pipeline that regenerates every model output from survey and published data (run_all.py, src/), the scripted figures, the tests and the Streamlit dashboard. Every number is labelled COMPUTED, MODELLED, CITED or ILLUSTRATIVE. The raw survey data are not included. Companion records: the report [Report DOI] and the aggregate data [Dataset DOI] (the two DOIs are filled in when version 1.0.0 is released; see the README).
